other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Arunachal Pradesh or an Arunachali currently living outside the state who wishes to return and start a business there
Applicant must have a concrete idea, plan, prototype or working model
Applicant must possess good communication skills
The venture must be an early‑stage startup established on or after 15 August 2015
The enterprise must be registered as an MSME
Applicant must be an existing entrepreneur in their district
Applicant must be a college graduate
Applicant should belong to organized producer groups
benefits_summary: Top 50 entrepreneurs receive incubation and pre‑incubation support, with up to ₹5 lakhs for the top 10 and up to ₹4 lakhs for the next 40, plus training, mentorship and access to government schemes.
